rootCause: The checksum verifier first validates two independently published immutable packs against their own manifests, then incorrectly requires their bytes to be identical. Satisfying that assertion would require prohibited historical rewriting. The analogous legacy V-named rollback archive must also be validated against its own retained manifest instead of rewritten to central bytes.
repairDirection: Keep both immutable histories unchanged; validate each migration pack independently; validate the legacy V-named rollback archive against its own manifest; retain exact parity only for modern R-named mirrored rollbacks; make central migration/flyway the executable runtime authority.
